mapper.select: SELECT d.DELIVERY_STATUS FROM ORDERDETAIL od JOIN DELIVERY d ON od.ORDER_ID = d.ORDER_ID WHERE od.OD_ID = #{odId}

SELECT od.OD_ID AS odId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, po.OPTION_NAME AS optionName, od.PRICE_FIX AS priceFix, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH AS productImagePath, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME AS productImageSaveName FROM ORDERDETAIL od JOIN PRODUCTORDER pord ON od.ORDER_ID = pord.ORDER_ID JOIN OPTIONDETAIL opd ON od.POP_ID = opd.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON opd.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION po ON opd.OPTION_ID = po.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCTIMAGE pi ON pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 WHERE od.OD_ID = #{odId} AND pord.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_REVIEW_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO REVIEW (REVIEW_ID, MEMBER_ID, OD_ID, REVIEW_TEXT, SCORE) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{memberId}, #{odId}, #{reviewText}, #{score})

INSERT INTO REVIEWIMAGE (REVIEW_IMAGE_ID, REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME, REVIEW_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME, REVIEW_IMAGE_PATH, REVIEW_TITLE_IMAGE) VALUES (SEQ_REVIEW_IMAGE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{reviewId}, #{reviewImageOriginalName}, #{reviewImage}, #{reviewImagePath}, #{reviewTitleImage})
